description:
## Why

PKIX-g9vc's foundation: limbo testcases supply per-case `validation_time` (RFC 3339 string). The current pkix-difftest uses `SystemTime::now()` everywhere, so a 2024 limbo case with a 2024-pinned cert and a 2026 wallclock will spuriously fail. Every oracle must see the same instant per chain.

## What

1. Add `pub validation_time_unix: Option<u64>` to `Chain` (`pkix-difftest/src/lib.rs:137-151`). Add a `with_validation_time(secs: u64)` builder. When `None`, oracles fall back to current behaviour (system clock) so PKITS / PEM-tree / pem-multi are unaffected.
2. **pkix-path oracle** (`src/oracles/pkix_path.rs:98-101`): replace the `SystemTime::now()` block with a read from `chain.validation_time_unix`, falling back to system time. The existing `check_revocation(..., now_unix: u64)` helper at line 132 already takes time as a param.
3. **OpenSSL oracle** (`src/oracles/openssl.rs:101-123`): when `chain.validation_time_unix` is `Some`, append `-attime <secs>` to the `openssl verify` argv. (Available in OpenSSL 1.1+; canonical mechanism for pinning verify time.)
4. **pyca oracle** (`src/oracles/pyca.rs:170-174` + `python/pyca_oracle.py:135-136`): serialise `validation_time` (unix seconds) into the JSON spec when set; on the Python side, build with `builder.time(datetime.fromtimestamp(unix_secs, tz=utc))` instead of `datetime.now(utc)`.
5. Unit tests: synthesize a short-lived self-signed chain (e.g. notBefore=2020 notAfter=2021), drive each oracle with `validation_time_unix` inside the window (pass) and outside (fail), confirm correct verdict from each oracle.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `Chain` has `validation_time_unix: Option<u64>` and a builder.
- [ ] All three oracles consume it; `None` preserves existing behaviour exactly.
- [ ] Integration test demonstrates a chain that passes at one time and fails at another for every oracle.
- [ ] No regressions in existing PKITS or PEM-tree baseline runs (manual spot-check OK; full regen deferred to .4).

## Out of scope

- LimboCorpus loader (PKIX-g9vc.2).
- CLI wiring (PKIX-g9vc.3).
- Baseline run (PKIX-g9vc.4).

## Filed as

Decomposition of PKIX-g9vc per AGENTS.md (>3 files, multi-step). Most-independent sub-bead; foundation for the loader.
title: pkix-difftest: thread validation_time_unix through Chain and all 3 oracles
